reviews.author: Ahmed khalil
reviews.text:
My experience at this gym was very disappointing, and unfortunately, I cannot recommend it.

I have been a member of this gym for 3 years. Last Friday, I came in for my workout without knowing that my membership had expired. I had previously changed my phone number and informed the gym management, so I never received any notification regarding the expiration of my membership.

While I was there, two trainers were talking to each other in a language I did not understand. Then one of them approached me and asked in a rude and unprofessional manner whether I had paid my membership fee or not. I found this behavior disrespectful and upsetting.

I went to the reception desk to ask about my membership status and why I had not received any notification. The response was indifferent, and when I raised my concern about the trainer’s attitude, no one addressed the issue or offered an apology.

It is disappointing to receive this kind of treatment after being a loyal member for three years. Overall, it was a very poor experience, and I hope the management improves the way they communicate with and respect their members.
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear AHMED KHALIL
Thank you for sharing your feedback and for being a member of our gym for the past three years.
We are sorry to hear that your recent experience left you disappointed. We value all our members and always strive to communicate respectfully and professionally.
Regarding your membership, our records show that the membership had expired 17 days prior to your visit, and an expiry notification was sent to the contact details available in our system. During your visit, our staff’s intention was only to inform you about the membership status so that we could assist you accordingly. We regret if this interaction came across differently than intended.
After learning about your concern, we also reached out to you via WhatsApp to apologize and clarify the situation, as maintaining a positive relationship with our members is very important to us.
We appreciate your feedback and will continue working to improve our communication and member experience. If you would like to discuss this matter further, we would be happy to speak with you directly.
Thank you for your support over the years, and we wish you all the best.
New OnTrack Fitness Management
